label: 2026-27 seasons
note: Hand-entered from the North Dakota Game and Fish proclamations. Each spring and summer the Department publishes new proclamations; collector/check_sources.py opens a GitHub issue when a source page changes so these dates can be updated.

goose_hours.note: Before that date, sunset on Wednesdays and Saturdays, 2 p.m. other days.

hours.big: Half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset
hours.small: Half an hour before sunrise to sunset
hours.goose: Half an hour before sunrise to 2 p.m. Through Nov. 28, Wednesdays and Saturdays run to sunset. From Nov. 29, every day runs to sunset.

seasons.name: Deer, archery
seasons.note: Nonresidents may hunt only private land, not PLOTS, through Sept. 13.

seasons.name: Deer, gun
seasons.note: Hunt the unit and type of deer on your license. Blaze orange required.

seasons.name: Deer, muzzleloader
seasons.note: White-tailed deer only. Blaze orange required.

seasons.name: Pronghorn, archery
seasons.note: Hunt the unit on your license.

seasons.name: Pronghorn, gun
seasons.note: Blaze orange required, bowhunters included.

seasons.name: Elk, units E3 and E4 (Badlands)
seasons.note: Other elk units nearby have different dates.

seasons.name: Bighorn sheep
seasons.note: Early season Oct. 30 to Nov. 13, late season Nov. 14 to Dec. 31.

seasons.name: Turkey, fall
seasons.note: Hunt the unit on your license.

seasons.name: Turkey, spring
seasons.note: Next spring's dates come with the new spring proclamation.

seasons.name: Mountain lion, Zone 1 early season
seasons.note: Closes early once eight lions are taken. Report a harvest within 12 hours.

seasons.name: Mountain lion, Zone 1 late season
seasons.note: Dogs allowed. Closes early at seven lions or three females.

seasons.name: Pheasant (roosters)
seasons.note: Youth weekend Oct. 3 and 4. Nonresidents may not hunt wildlife management areas or PLOTS Oct. 10 to 16.

seasons.name: Sharp-tailed grouse
seasons.note: 3 a day, 12 in possession.

seasons.name: Hungarian partridge
seasons.note: 3 a day, 12 in possession.

seasons.name: Sage grouse
seasons.note: No season this year.

seasons.name: Mourning dove
seasons.note: 15 a day, Eurasian collared doves included.

seasons.name: Ducks, High Plains unit
seasons.license: Waterfowl licenses, federal duck stamp (16 and older), HIP
seasons.note: Split season: closed Dec. 7 to 11. Medora is in the High Plains unit.

seasons.name: Canada geese, Western zone
seasons.license: Waterfowl licenses, federal duck stamp (16 and older), HIP
seasons.note: 8 a day.

seasons.name: Snow and Ross's geese
seasons.license: Waterfowl licenses, federal duck stamp (16 and older), HIP
seasons.note: 50 a day, no possession limit.

seasons.name: Sandhill crane
seasons.license: Sandhill crane permit plus small game or waterfowl license, HIP
seasons.note: 3 a day west of U.S. Highway 281.

seasons.name: Coyote and fox
seasons.note: Open all year. Night hunting on foot Nov. 23 to May 31.

seasons.name: Bobcat, Zone 1
seasons.note: Dogs and cable devices from Nov. 23.

seasons.name: Hook and line fishing
seasons.note: Open all year on most waters. National wildlife refuges are closed except areas the refuge opens.

restrictions.text: Nonresidents may not hunt anything on wildlife management areas or PLOTS from Oct. 10 to 16 (the first week of pheasant season), unless hunting PLOTS land they own.
Nonresident deer bowhunters may hunt only private land, not PLOTS, through Sept. 13.

fish_limits: Channel catfish, west of N.D. Highway 1
